column1: # The lines an account run prints in fleet mode (gird-check.sh --account-run, gird-check.ps1
# -AccountRun), one per key, in this order, and nothing else. Root on a Mac (gird-fleet.sh) and
# gird-fleet.ps1 read them in this order and refuse any other. One line each, tab separated. After
# editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh, which writes the keys into gird-fleet.sh and gird-fleet.ps1 and
# fails when the lines gird-check.sh or gird-check.ps1 prints are not these, in this order.
#   key     the key: lowercase letters and _
#   kind    one (always 1), ids (ids from a fixed list, separated by spaces), number, flag (0 or 1)
#           or word (one of a few words the readers name)
